title: Chapter 601 - 601 One Month; Golden Treasure Chest!

Chapter 601 - 601 One Month; Golden Treasure Chest!

Chapter 601 - 601 One Month; Golden Treasure Chest!

601 One Month; Golden Treasure Chest!

As the red forest descended, many people even hurriedly fled Yang City.

They were afraid that the red monsters would come out.

The government had even hurriedly mobilized armed soldiers, animal and plant experts, and other scholars to gather in front of the red forest.

They did not find any terrifying red monsters during their careful exploration.

On the contrary, they found that the air in the red forest was very fresh. After breathing in it for a period of time, the pain in their bodies gradually disappeared.

The longer they breathed in the air in the red forest, the stronger their bodies became.

It was extremely strange.

…

Lin Fan had no idea what was happening in the real world.

In the blink of an eye, another five days passed.

In these five days, Lin Fan did not encounter any beasts or monsters.

By relying on living in the Otherworld, Lin Fan gained a total of 800 Constitution points and 600 spiritual energy points.

Today, Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam continued to move forward in the wilderness.

At this moment, an emotionless voice sounded in the ears of everyone in the Otherworld.

“You’ve been in the Otherworld for 30 days. You’ve obtained a golden treasure chest.”

Then, in front of Lin Fan and Sam, a chest shining with golden light appeared.

Lin Fan had seen too many chests like this.

Therefore, with a calm expression, he reached out and opened it.

[You’ve obtained Beginner Earth Manipulation Technique. Do you want to use it?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—Advanced Earth Manipulation Technique.]

Instantly, Lin Fan lowered his head and looked over. The originally hard ground was suddenly filled with countless tiny particles.

Lin Fan could clearly feel that as long as he willed it, these particles could gather with his thoughts and transform into different forms.

When Lin Fan raised his head, he realized that Sam was staring at the golden treasure chest in front of him.

If he had never used the things in the box before, it would have been fine.

However, Lin Fan had let him use it before.

Sam also knew that these chests contained very strange power.

Lin Fan said, “This is the reward from the Otherworld. Use it and see what you can get.”

When Sam heard this, he hurriedly replied, “Yes, Master!”

Then, he opened the chest impatiently.

[You’ve obtained Beginner Gigantization Technique. Do you want to use it?]

Sam looked at the ball of light in the golden treasure chest and blinked.

Then, he looked at Lin Fan again.

Lin Fan said, “This is your skill. Use it.”

Then, Lin Fan said to the Heavenly Hound, “Use this Beginner Earth Manipulation Technique.”

Thus, Sam and the Heavenly Hound both touched the balls of light in front of them.

The balls of light circled around them and then entered their bodies.

Very soon, both of their faces revealed a hint of joy.

Lin Fan did not really care about the Beginner Earth Manipulation Technique.

That was because he himself had the Advanced Earth Manipulation Technique.

Lin Fan asked Sam, “What abilities does your Beginner Gigantization Technique have?”

“I can enlarge any part of my body!” Sam said excitedly.

As he spoke, his fist was like a balloon, constantly expanding.

Soon, it became a meter-long giant fist.

“Master, look! It’s a fist bigger than a clay pot!” Sam said.

Lin Fan’s lips twitched as a weird look appeared on his face.

…

Lin Fan and Sam knew that there were good things in the treasure chests.

However, those who had never successfully killed a ferocious beast did not know.

After living in the Otherworld for a month, the other heroes were all sallow and emaciated.

Therefore, when a chest appeared in front of them, they did not open it immediately but hurriedly avoided it.

They did not know if there would be any danger.

Of course, there were also some bold and curious people who picked up wooden sticks and pried open the box from afar, thus obtaining different abilities.

…

In Nashland’s live broadcast room.

The host picked up the microphone and said excitedly, “Look! What happened? All six of our current heroes have obtained treasure chests. Let’s see what kind of power they can obtain!”

Originally, there were more than ten heroes from Nashland who had entered the Otherworld.

At this moment, there were only six people left.

Some of these heroes were killed by ferocious beasts, while others starved to death…

There was even one person who walked into the mangroves and was eaten by the red monsters.

Fredo: [Six treasure chests! It seems that no country has ever obtained so many treasure chests!]

Irwin: [As expected, our country’s luck is strong!]

MMM: [Why aren’t you opening the treasure chest? Don’t hesitate!]

ONE: [William has opened it. Oh my god, it’s 300 points of Constitution. Ten points of Constitution is enough to make one like Superman. 300 points of Constitution… What kind of power will that have?]

WY: [Jani has also opened a treasure chest. Let me see… Lycanthropy! Could it be that he can transform into a werewolf? Wolverine! Amazing!]

Hero: [Kate is about to open it… Heavens! It’s the Fog Controlling Spell! It sounds very powerful!]

…

Eagle Country’s live broadcast room.

UU: [Andrew has opened the treasure chest! Is it a physical weapon? Heavens! His body can actually turn into a sharp blade. He’s so strong now!]

Henry: [If that’s the case, who can be his opponent in the future?]

Mark: [I knew it. Andrew must be the strongest.]

…

In Fray’s live broadcast room.

K: [Qiao Yashu obtained 400 Constitution points!]
